channel.title: Korea Plainly: guides
channel.description: Plain-English guides for first-time visitors to Korea.

item.title: Temple Stay Programs in Korea: What Happens and Who They Suit
item.description: Learn what to expect at a Korean temple stay, from meditation and temple meals to overnight routines, plus practical advice on choosing a program.

item.title: Things to Do in Seoul with Kids: An Easy Family Guide
item.description: Plan a family-friendly Seoul trip with ideas for parks, museums, indoor attractions, and practical tips for getting around with children.

item.title: WOWPASS Card in Korea: How the Prepaid Travel Card Works
item.description: Learn how to get, load and use a WOWPASS card in Korea, including its separate payment and transit balances, and what to check before relying on it.

item.title: Using Papago and Other Translation Apps in Korea
item.description: Learn how to use Papago, Google Translate, and other translation tools for menus, signs, conversations, and everyday tasks while visiting Korea.

item.title: Korea in April: Cherry Blossoms, Weather and What to Pack
item.description: Visiting Korea in April: cherry blossom season in Seoul and beyond, spring weather, fine dust, what to wear and how to beat the crowds.

item.title: Korea in May: Weather, Holidays and What to Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in May: warm sunny weather, the Lotus Lantern Festival for Buddha's Birthday, Children's Day crowds, roses and what to pack.

item.title: Korea in June: Weather, Rainy Season and What to Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in June: early summer heat, when the rainy season starts, what to pack, beaches, hydrangeas on Jeju and indoor plans for wet days.

item.title: Korea in July: Weather, Monsoon, Festivals and What to Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in July: monsoon rain then summer heat, what to pack, beaches, the Boryeong Mud Festival, staying cool and planning around typhoons.

item.title: Korea in August: Heat, Holidays and How to Enjoy It
item.description: Visiting Korea in August: the hottest month, typhoon season, peak holiday crowds, beaches and valleys, staying cool in the city and Liberation Day.

item.title: Korea in September: Weather, Chuseok and What to Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in September: the end of summer heat, the Chuseok harvest holiday and how it affects travel, typhoons, early autumn flowers and festivals.

item.title: Best Time to Visit Korea: A Month-by-Month Guide
item.description: When to visit South Korea: the best months for weather, blossoms, autumn leaves, festivals, skiing and lower prices, with a guide to every month and holidays to plan around.

item.title: Where to Exchange Money in Korea (and Get the Best Rate)
item.description: Exchanging money in Korea: airport vs city banks vs Myeongdong money changers, WOWPASS kiosks, which currencies get the best rates, ATMs and what to do with leftover won.

item.title: Noraebang: How Korean Karaoke Rooms Work
item.description: A practical guide to visiting a Korean noraebang, from choosing a room and finding songs to handling the bill and following local etiquette.

item.title: Olive Young in Korea: How to Shop for K-Beauty as a Visitor
item.description: How to shop at Olive Young in Korea: flagship stores in Myeongdong and Gangnam, instant tax refunds, sale periods, what to buy first and how to pay.

item.title: Lotte World or Everland? Choosing a Seoul Theme Park
item.description: Lotte World or Everland? How Seoul's two big theme parks compare: indoor or outdoor, rides and animals, getting there, queues, tickets and the best season for each.

item.title: Jeju in Winter: Tangerines, Camellias and Snow on Hallasan
item.description: Jeju in winter: weather and wind, tangerine picking, camellia gardens, snowy Hallasan hikes and reservations, driving, flight delays and what to pack.

item.title: Visiting the DMZ from Seoul: How to Choose a Tour
item.description: How to visit the DMZ from Seoul: what a tour actually shows you, the JSA question, how to pick an operator, passports, closing days and what to expect on the day.

item.title: Nami Island and Gapyeong: An Easy Day Trip from Seoul
item.description: How to visit Nami Island and Gapyeong from Seoul: train, shuttle bus or tour, the ferry, what to do on the island, nearby sights and the best seasons.

item.title: Renting a Hanbok in Seoul: Free Palace Entry and What to Expect
item.description: How hanbok rental works in Seoul: where to rent, what it costs, how long it takes, free entry to the royal palaces in hanbok, closing days and photo tips.

item.title: K-Pop in Seoul: A Fan's Guide to Stores, Stars and Shows
item.description: A practical K-pop guide to Seoul for first-time visitors: album and merch stores, agency buildings, music show audiences, fan cafés and the etiquette that matters.

item.title: Vegetarian, Vegan and Halal Food in Korea: How to Eat Well
item.description: How to eat vegetarian, vegan or halal in Korea: hidden fish and meat in Korean food, safe dishes, temple food, phrases to show staff, halal restaurant levels and prayer rooms.

item.title: Sick in Korea? Pharmacies, Hospitals and Emergency Numbers
item.description: What to do if you get ill or hurt in Korea: emergency numbers, free interpretation, pharmacies and late-night medicine, clinics, international hospital centres and costs.

item.title: Maisan and Tapsa: Korea's Temple of Hand-Stacked Stone Towers
item.description: A visitor's guide to Maisan's twin peaks and Tapsa, the temple of 80 stone towers stacked without mortar, near Jeonju: when to go, getting there and what to see.

item.title: Gungnamji Pond in Buyeo: Korea's Oldest Garden Pond, by Day and Night
item.description: A local's guide to Gungnamji in Buyeo, the Baekje kingdom's 7th-century royal pond: the island pavilion, willow walks, the July lotus festival, night views and getting there.

item.title: Do You Tip in Korea? What Visitors Should Know
item.description: Tipping is not a normal part of everyday service in Korea. Learn what to expect at restaurants, in taxis, at hotels, and on tours—and what to do if a tip is requested.

item.title: New Year Sunrise in Korea: Where to Watch the First Sunrise
item.description: Where to see the first sunrise of the year in Korea on 1 January: east coast beaches, Jeju and Seoul hilltops, sunrise times, getting there and staying warm.

item.title: Seoul or Busan? How to Choose (or Do Both) on Your First Trip
item.description: Seoul vs Busan for first-time visitors: what each city is like, sights, food, beaches, costs and weather, how to split your days, and getting between them by KTX.

item.title: Korea in March: Weather, What to Pack and What to Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in March: how cold it still is, what to wear, the first plum and cherry blossoms in the south, fine dust, holidays and what to do.

item.title: Korea in October: Weather, What to Pack and What to Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in October: crisp autumn weather, the first autumn leaves, the film festival in Busan, fireworks in Seoul, lantern and mask festivals, and public holidays.

item.title: Korean Phrases Cheat Sheet: A Printable Page for Your Trip
item.description: A one-page printable Korean cheat sheet for travellers: greetings, restaurant and café phrases, menu words, getting around, shopping and help, in Hangul with easy pronunciation.

item.title: Korea in November: Seoul, Busan and Jeju Weather and What to Pack
item.description: Korea in November: Seoul, Busan and Jeju weather, what to wear, the last autumn leaves, kimchi-making season, festivals and the exam day that stops planes.

item.title: Best Night Views in Seoul: Where to See the City Lights
item.description: Where to see Seoul at night: N Seoul Tower, the old city wall at Naksan Park, Seoul Sky, Han River bridges, Cheonggyecheon and more, with tips on timing and getting there.

item.title: Cherry Blossom in Korea 2027: When and Where to See It
item.description: When cherry blossom is expected in Korea in 2027, from Jeju and Busan in late March to Seoul in early April, the best places to see it and how to plan around the crowds.

item.title: How Much Does a Trip to Korea Cost? A Daily Budget Guide
item.description: A plain daily budget for Korea: what hotels, food, transport and sights cost, three sample budgets from backpacker to comfortable, and easy ways to save.

item.title: How to Ride the KTX: Booking Korea's High-Speed Trains
item.description: A practical guide to booking KTX tickets, choosing the right station and seat, and finding your train on travel day.

item.title: Korea in December: Seoul, Busan and Jeju Weather and What to Pack
item.description: Korea in December: Seoul, Busan and Jeju weather, what to wear, Christmas lights, the Seoul lantern festival, first ski days and New Year's Eve at Bosingak.

item.title: Korea in January: Seoul, Busan and Jeju Weather and What to Pack
item.description: Korea in January: Seoul, Busan and Jeju weather in the coldest month, what to wear, ice fishing festivals, skiing, snowy palaces and New Year's Day tips.

item.title: Korea in February: Weather, Seollal and What to Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in February: still cold but warming up, Lunar New Year (Seollal) on 6-9 February 2027, the last ski weeks, snow festivals and early signs of spring in the south.

item.title: Korea's Winter Festivals: Ice Fishing, Snow and Lights
item.description: The best winter festivals in Korea for visitors: Hwacheon's trout ice fishing, Pyeongchang, Taebaek's snow sculptures, Seoul's lantern festival and winter light gardens, with how to get there.

item.title: 7 Days in Korea: A First-Timer's Itinerary (Seoul, Gyeongju, Busan)
item.description: A one-week Korea itinerary for first-time visitors: three days in Seoul, a day trip, ancient Gyeongju and the beaches of Busan, linked by fast KTX trains, with a Jeju alternative.

item.title: 10 Days to 2 Weeks in Korea: An Easy Itinerary
item.description: A 10-day Korea itinerary for first-time visitors: Seoul, Jeonju's hanok village, Gyeongju, Busan and Jeju, with how to stretch it to two weeks with the east coast and Seoraksan.

item.title: 5 Days in Seoul: A Relaxed Itinerary for First-Timers
item.description: Five days in Seoul for first-time visitors: palaces and hanok lanes, markets and Namsan, Hongdae and the Han River, Gangnam and Jamsil, and a day trip to the DMZ or Suwon.

item.title: First Trip to Korea? Start Here: A Step-by-Step Planner
item.description: Planning your first trip to Korea, step by step: when to go, how long to stay, entry rules, money, phones, getting from the airport, getting around and what to know on the ground.

item.title: Learn to Read Hangul in an Hour: Korean Alphabet for Travellers
item.description: Learn to read the Korean alphabet before your trip: every letter with its sound, how syllable blocks work, a read-the-sign quiz and a memory game, with real words from Korean signs and menus.

item.title: Korea Packing List: What to Bring in Every Season (Interactive Checklist)
item.description: An interactive packing list for Korea: pick your season and tick off documents, money, phone and apps, clothes, health and handy extras. Your ticks are saved, and you can print it.

item.title: Korea Trip Cost Calculator: How Much Will Your Trip Cost?
item.description: Work out a rough budget for your trip to Korea: choose how many days, your travel style, KTX trains and a Jeju flight, and see the cost per person in won and your own currency.

item.title: Which Korean City Suits You? Take the Quiz
item.description: Seoul, Busan, Jeju, Gyeongju, Jeonju or Gangneung? Answer five quick questions and Kkachi the magpie will tell you which Korean city fits your travel style, with a guide to plan the trip.

item.title: Festivals in Korea: What's On This Month and Coming Up
item.description: A festival calendar for Korea, updated every week: what is on now and coming up across the country, from food and lantern festivals to fireworks, flowers and ice fishing.

item.title: How to Eat Korean BBQ: A Step-by-Step Guide for Visitors
item.description: Learn what to order, how to cook the meat, and how to make a Korean BBQ wrap, with practical tips for your first visit.

item.title: Korea in Winter: What to Expect, Pack and Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in winter: how cold it gets, what to pack, skiing, ice festivals, Christmas lights, warming street food and what to watch out for.
